single.rationale: Tarsus shows exceptional commercial execution with XDEMVY revenue accelerating from $183M (2024) to $451M (2025), a 147% YoY growth rate, while simultaneously improving cash burn dramatically (OCF improved from -$83M to -$13M). The company has achieved strong market penetration as one of the best-selling prescription eye drops with FDA-approved first-in-class status, maintaining 90%+ insurance coverage, and the pipeline (TP-04 for ocular rosacea, TP-05 for Lyme disease) addresses large underserved markets with the same lotilaner API, suggesting capital-efficient expansion opportunities.
